content.text:
## Audit

The page is built entirely from native, semantic elements — `<a>`, `<button>`, `<input>` — inside proper `<header>`/`<nav>`/`<main>` landmarks. There are no custom widgets, no dialogs, and no dynamically-injected content, so most of the contract's items (ARIA widget patterns, focus trapping, arrow-key navigation, inert backgrounds) simply don't apply here — nothing in the page requires them.

I checked each contract requirement against the markup:

- **Tab order** — matches DOM order, which matches visual/reading order. No `tabindex` overrides needed.
- **Enter/Space activation** — all controls are native `<a>` and `<button type="button">`, so the browser already provides correct default activation semantics; no custom key handling was needed (or added).
- **Color contrast** — verified nav links (#3b434c), body text (#46505b), and both button fills (#22272e, #2456c4) against their backgrounds; all comfortably exceed 4.5:1 for text.
- **Labels** — the search `<input>` has `aria-label="Search the docs"`, matching its visible placeholder text (Label in Name).
- **Landmarks/bypass** — header, nav, and main wrap all content, satisfying the bypass-blocks requirement without needing a separate skip link.

**The one real defect:** a global `*:focus { outline: none }` rule stripped the focus indicator from every interactive element on the page — links, the search input, and both buttons. That's a direct violation of the "visible focus indicator on every interactive element" requirement (WCAG 2.4.7).

## Fix

Replaced the blanket `outline: none` with a `:focus-visible` rule scoped to the actual interactive elements:

```css
a:focus-visible, button:focus-visible, input:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid #2456c4;
  outline-offset: 2px;
}
```

- Used `outline-offset: 2px` so the ring renders outside each element's fill — important for the two buttons, one of which (`.banner button`) already uses `#2456c4` as its own background, so an inset outline in the same color would have been invisible.
- Verified the outline color against every background it can appear on (white header/main, the light-blue banner) — all exceed the 3:1 non-text contrast minimum.
- Used `:focus-visible` rather than `:focus` so keyboard users get the ring while mouse clicks don't show an unwanted outline flash; this doesn't weaken the guarantee since every element is native and keyboard-focusable by default.

## Left alone

- All `data-track` attributes, `id`s, and the `window.__activated` instrumentation script — untouched.
- Markup structure, visual design, and copy — unchanged.
- No dialogs, tab panels, menus, or other composite widgets exist, so no ARIA patterns or arrow-key handling were added — adding them would have been scope creep against a page that has none of those constructs.

This was a one-rule diff; everything else in the page already met the contract natively.

status_detail: focus indicator defect fixed; outline rule scoped to :focus-visible
